actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Finance.

dimensions.assessment: Affects Medicare beneficiaries who receive outpatient observation services in a hospital and subsequently seek skilled nursing facility services.
dimensions.evidence: an individual receiving outpatient observation services in a hospital as an inpatient for purposes of satisfying the three-day inpatient hospital-stay requirement

dimensions.assessment: Changes qualification rules for skilled nursing facility coverage, altering out-of-pocket or insurance coverage for affected individuals.
dimensions.evidence: coverage of skilled nursing facility (SNF) services under Medicare

dimensions.assessment: Potentially increases Medicare spending by expanding skilled nursing facility coverage eligibility to patients previously classified only as outpatients, though exact figures are not stated.
Amends a specific section of the Social Security Act regarding hospital inpatient status definitions for Medicare.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title XVIII of the Social Security Act to count a period of receipt of outpatient observation services

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent change to Medicare eligibility rules starting January 1, 2026, with provisions for certain past appeals within a 90-day window.
dimensions.evidence: apply to receipt of outpatient observation services beginning on or after January 1, 2026

missing_information: Specific cost estimates or exact number of annual beneficiaries affected.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill amends Medicare rules to count outpatient observation time toward the three-day inpatient stay requirement for skilled nursing facility coverage, affecting Medicare beneficiaries receiving observation services and post-hospital care.
